summary.text: Donna Givens, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 64 since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: She graduated from Robertsdale High School and earned a degree from Mobile College.
Her career experience includes working with Baldwin EMC, and she has served as chair of the North Baldwin Chamber of Commerce and the Central Baldwin Chamber of Commerce.
